8) Anti-overcommit rule: when a lone unit faces a clustered 3+ enemy stack, do not move onto the enemy-occupied stack unless it produces an immediate decisive kill advantage this turn; otherwise choose a retreat/safe fast_move endpoint.
9) Pressure/contact: Otherwise choose the most aggressive legal move/fast_move that most reduces distance to key enemies/objectives and creates next-turn contact. For pressure-only move choices, prefer endpoints that are on-axis toward immediate contact (avoid sideways drift when a direct contact lane exists). If every candidate move is non-lethal after predicted damage, prefer the shortest path to the primary threat (lowest hex_dist) over a detour that only shaves predicted damage.
